justification: Populate AustLII URLs for 23 LEPs (DB UPDATE only, no schema change) and add Cloudflare challenge detection to AustLII Playwright fetcher. No new queries beyond the existing monitor flow.

pre_impl.reason: DB UPDATE SET on existing column (austlii_url). Playwright fix adds challenge polling loop identical to existing NSW Legislation function.

functions: fetch_as_at_playwright() now polls for Cloudflare challenge resolution before extracting version date, matching the existing pattern in _fetch_nsw_legislation_version_playwright()
values: 23 austlii_url values populated from verified web search results
queries: N/A - no new queries, existing UPDATE instrument_registry SET austlii_url pattern

break_it.scenario: AustLII URL is wrong for an instrument (404 or different LEP)
break_it.what_happens: Playwright loads the page, finds no version pattern, reports error for that instrument. Does not corrupt DB.
break_it.repro: Manually change one URL to a bad path and run --dry-run
break_it.how: Per-instrument error handling catches and reports; wrong URL produces error not silent wrong data

break_it.scenario: Cloudflare challenge loop times out on AustLII (30s not enough)
break_it.what_happens: RuntimeError raised, caught by check_via_austlii, instrument reported as fetch error
break_it.repro: Run from a fully blocked IP
break_it.how: Same error path as before but now with explicit Cloudflare detection rather than misleading 'format changed' message

post_merge.db_reset: N/A - austlii_url already populated via one-off script
post_merge.manual_verify: Trigger workflow_dispatch to confirm all 25 instruments are now checked via AustLII
